description: Type erasure hides a concrete type behind a common interface. You can compare callable storage, general value storage, and a declared set of alternatives.

steps.description: std::function gives different callables the same call interface. op successively holds an addition lambda, an addition object, and a capturing multiplication lambda.
The vector holds string transformations with one shared function signature. Each lambda supplies a different transformation.
The loop calls each stored transformation on input. The comments show the example's stated results.
std::any stores a value whose concrete type can change. any_cast requests a type, and the try block shows the exception for a mismatched request.
std::variant declares its possible types in advance and tracks the active one. std::visit calls a function with the currently held value.

title: Store values behind common interfaces
